title: Grateful Dead Live at Euphoria Ballroom on 1970-07-16

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a stellar second set highlighted by a blazing Not Fade Away, gorgeous Attics performance, and a seamless NFA → St. Stephen transition.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised as an “awesome” SBD master with crystal‑clear mix and outrageous guitar tone, making the music shine.  The show itself stands out for Bob Weir’s top‑form playing on Not Fade Away, the beautiful Attics rendition, tight interplay between Jerry and Bob, and a superb NFA into St. Stephen segue that keeps the energy soaring throughout.

ai_rating.rationale: All eight reviews are detailed and overwhelmingly positive about both performance (standout jams, guitar work) and recording quality (excellent SBD mix), yielding a high combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Multiple reviewers call the tape an "awesome recording" with a great mix, crystal‑clear guitar tone and no noted flaws; identified as the final classic‑era Bear SBD master.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set flows superbly, featuring a tightly‑woven NFA jam that segues flawlessly into St. Stephen; the energy stays high with strong guitar interplay and dynamic full‑band moments.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Jerry’s guitar tone is repeatedly praised and his interplay with Bob during the Not Fade Away jam is highlighted as a show highlight.
band_member_comments.Bob: Bob (Weir) is described as "on top of his game" with standout rhythm/lead work on Not Fade Away and throughout the set.
